Native duplicate revision is original receipt revision; legacy response revision is current snapshot revision.

Bind attack.Revision to receipt and later ResolvedRevision to response; attack ID is not command ID. Effective damage packet is not retained actual HP loss. Retained-seed authenticity reconstruction belongs to execution/restore.
Offer accepted does not prove completed child movement. CostPaid has move-kind-specific semantics; transient active Press does not retain all historical arming/expiry.

Original source command/revision and later resolution cause/revision are separate. Retarget continuation uses response ID/current revision. Current assessment stages FinishSanctuary on a copy then resolves; new read path needs pure context.

IsSuspended is matching manufacturing/recovery pending-clock convention, not all tactical decisions. Core AcceptedResult does not exhaust Recovery/Ferry contact records. No universal historical elapsed-time delta ledger.

Rest start differs from actual end/benefit. Cleric long rest genuinely stores completion before/after settlement values. Strain removal uses offer completion time with later resolver revision and is not healing/revival.
Current per-field rights are required. Visible opponent position is not private life/defense access. ClockGrant is not blanket inventory/actor disclosure.

Both controllers bypass session Execute, assess primary/fallback and discard actual CommandResult internally. Carry actual dispatched command and native/admission result through their existing Dispatch/Execute path; do not rerun. Explain automatic LaterDefender receipts with the actual principal.
